basics.name: Priyanka Chatterjee
basics.label: AI Backend Engineer · 9,300★ Open-Source Contributor · Python · RAG · MCP · 3.5+ Years

summaries.learntube-ai-backend: AI Backend Engineer with 3.5+ years building agentic AI systems — Model Context Protocol servers, multi-agent LLM orchestration, and RAG — in Python, backed by production backend and data-layer work across MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Docker, and AWS. Built the Steampipe MCP server end to end and a RAG-based Pydantic AI agent (deployed to AWS Lambda with streaming output) at Turbot HQ — one of 120+ merged pull requests across its 9,300★ open-source suite.

work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
highlights: Built a RAG-based internal Pydantic AI agent in Python to resolve cross-team queries by ingesting the documentation and code graph for all internal repos into AWS S3 vector storage via embeddings; deployed it to AWS Lambda and integrated it with the Slack Bot API as the UI, resolving onboarding and cross-team queries instantly.

Designed a multi-agent workflow on the OpenAI Agents SDK to orchestrate LLM agents that generate cloud preventive-policy commands, validate them in a live test environment, self-correct failures, and score accounts against an internal security metric.
Built the Steampipe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server end to end in Python, giving LLM agents standardized, real-time access to enterprise cloud and security data for retrieval and analysis.

Debugged a production performance bottleneck by reading the query plan for slow PostgreSQL compliance-audit queries — rewriting AWS IAM policy-evaluation queries with jsonb array elements and multi-stage CTEs, fixing the underlying indexing rather than the symptom — improving query performance 40% across 10,000+ resources.
Diagnosed and resolved a production incident by reading pod logs and status for a Go service stuck in a Kubernetes CrashLoopBackOff, collaborating with the platform team to restore service.

Designed and developed an internal REST API microservice in Go using the Gin framework as part of a greenfield build of Turbot Guardrails, a Preventive Security Posture Management (PSPM) SaaS product; secured endpoints with OAuth 2.0 (Auth0), containerized with Docker, and deployed to AWS EC2.

projects.name: General-Purpose AI Chatbot / Agent (Model Context Protocol)
projects.description: Agentic chatbot/agent framework built with Pydantic AI featuring configurable external MCP servers via a persistent MongoDB-backed registry, JSON config loader with strict input validation, per-server failure isolation, native tool calling, mid-conversation multi-model switching (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, Mistral), conversation-history persistence, sync + streaming output, prompt-injection safeguards, and Logfire observability.
